services.name: 2020 Exhibitions
services.desc: The Gravity of Light brings together seven contemporary artists who use light as material and lightness as a physical experience. Through photography, video, drawing, and installation, the artists use color, shadow, and contrast to emphasize how light affects our physical experience. This exhibition responds to the ecological crisis facing coral reefs through an expansive act of collective making.
